baseline_models.focus_anchor: The covenant verb at word 2 is joined to the filial address at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: A preserved instruction that requires continuing care is entrusted to a lineage, so the prohibition is framed as inherited custody rather than an isolated command.

activation_trace.role: Ongoing preservation and repeated care make the charge something that must be actively maintained.
An advance instruction deposited for safekeeping supplies the legal and temporal shape of the charge.
Descent from an origin turns the addressees into successive bearers of the same entrusted prohibition.

changed_reading.before: A past command is recalled to a group of human beings.
changed_reading.after: A maintained charge is recalled to a lineage responsible for carrying it through successive generations.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prohibited service at word 8 directly governs the named rebel at word 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: Obedient service can pass into self-enslavement and can smooth a road through repeated compliance; the warning therefore reaches conduct that grants mastery, not only formal cult.

activation_trace.role: Humble obedience supplies the ordinary service relation at the center of the prohibition.
Turning someone into a slave exposes the endpoint of obedience that yields agency to another.
A leveled, well-trodden road makes repeated compliance function as path construction.
The insolent rebel identifies the beneficiary of the yielded obedience.

changed_reading.before: Do not perform worship for Satan.
changed_reading.after: Do not let repeated obedience make Satan your master or turn his direction into your traveled road.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The named rebel at word 9 is predicated as an enemy at word 12.
baseline_models.mechanism: Distance, crooked opposition, boundary violation, and diversion combine into a directional account of enmity: the enemy works by moving the addressee away and across the proper limit.

activation_trace.role: Remoteness and severance supply the enemy's distancing effect.
Crooked opposition supplies the change of direction by which distance is produced.
Crossing a rightful boundary makes hostility operative as transgression.
Passing beyond and turning aside make the enemy a diverter rather than merely an opponent.

changed_reading.after: Satan's hostility is the directional work of severing, bending, crossing the limit, and diverting the addressee.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final adjective at word 13 qualifies the enemy relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Clarity and separation coexist in the qualifying root, allowing hostility to be manifest through the divisions and exposed consequences it produces.

activation_trace.role: Separation after connection supplies an observable product of hostility.
Emergence into visibility makes the enemy relation evidentially exposed.
Disclosure by speech or sign makes consequences capable of testifying to the relation.
The opposed-to-ally relation gives the disclosed separation its social polarity.

changed_reading.after: The enemy becomes plain in the separation he produces and in the signs that expose that hostile relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inscribed consequence, surviving trace, and an instruction connected onward turn the focus covenant into a relay whose failure can outlast one generation.

activation_trace.role: The deposited advance instruction anchors the focus as a charge intended to survive its first hearing.
Lineal descent supplies the sequence of recipients through which the charge can pass.
Binding inscription makes what people send ahead durable and answerable.
A remaining mark makes one generation's movement legible after it has passed.
An instruction joined onward to another supplies the explicit relay mechanism that sudden interruption prevents.

structural_cues: 36:6 places warning beside forebears left unwarned and therefore heedless.
36:12 preserves advances and traces, while 36:50 removes time for a final instruction or return to family.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies durable record, surviving trace, connected instruction, and interrupted family return; I infer that the focus charge is designed for intergenerational transmission, while a wholly individual covenant remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The lineage receives an inherited prohibition.
changed_reading.after: Each generation is a relay station charged to preserve and transmit the prohibition before its own opportunity closes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly places service, following, error, sight, and a straight road in one directional system; service is therefore the repeated conduct by which a route is made traversable.

activation_trace.role: A road leveled by use makes obedience cumulative and directional.
Crooked opposition supplies the rival direction that repeated service follows.
The straight road supplies the governing spatial alternative to the rival route.
Obedient service is directly placed beside the straight road, linking allegiance to direction.
Loss of the intended course supplies the result of serving the rival direction.
A ruined place and cut-off track show directional failure becoming an unusable route.

structural_cues: The straight road frames the surah at 36:4 and returns immediately after the focus at 36:61.
Following at 36:11 and 36:20-21, return at 36:22, error at 36:62, and failed path-finding at 36:66-67 form one movement sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies service beside the straight road, following, loss of course, and an effaced track; I infer that repeated obedience lays a practical route, while formal ritual worship remains included rather than displaced.

changed_reading.before: The prohibition concerns an isolated act of worship.
changed_reading.after: The prohibition concerns repeated compliance that lays Satan's route underfoot until it becomes one's operative path.

context_deltas.mechanism: A long tether in the named rebel's root meets collars, barriers, a halter image in reason, and erased sight; voluntary service hardens into a system that constrains neck, movement, judgment, and vision.

activation_trace.role: A long, tightly twisted tether supplies the material model for remote control through attachment.
Enslavement supplies the change from chosen compliance to constrained agency.
A collar that binds an organ makes the loss of agency bodily and visible.
Barriers closing the gap convert attachment into blocked forward and backward movement.
The camel-halter image makes failed reasoning another form of being bound.
Erased light and sight complete the constraint by removing orientation.

structural_cues: 36:8-9 moves from a bound neck to barriers and absent sight.
36:62 asks about reason after mass misdirection, and 36:66 again joins lost sight to the road.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tether, collar, barriers, halter, and erased sight; I infer a hardening sequence from voluntary service to comprehensive constraint, while these images can also remain parallel consequences rather than stages.

changed_reading.before: Serving the enemy means giving him allegiance.
changed_reading.after: Giving him allegiance fastens a tether that can harden into bodily, cognitive, and directional captivity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation supplies an origin and repeated return language supplies an endpoint; the rebel's distance becomes alienation from both where the human line begins and where it is going.

activation_trace.role: Remoteness and severance anchor the enemy's operation as induced distance.
Descent keeps the addressed line attached to a point of origin.
Origination supplies the source from which the worshipper understands himself to proceed.
Return to a prior point supplies the destination paired with worship of the originator.
The suddenly unavailable return to family makes severance temporally irreversible.
The surah's final return closes the directional arc at its governing endpoint.

structural_cues: 36:22 places worship of the originator beside return, while 36:31 and 36:67 stage failed return.
36:83 closes the whole surah with universal return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies origin, lineage, severance, and repeated return endpoints; I infer that the enemy's distance is relational alienation from source and destination, while literal spatial and eschatological return remain live.

changed_reading.before: Satan is remote and makes others remote.
changed_reading.after: Satan's service estranges the human line from its originating relation and from the return that gives its movement an endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: Barriers first hide sight, but final sorting, articulate limbs, testimony, and exposure of inner and outer acts make hostility manifest by its accumulated separations and evidence.

activation_trace.role: Separation after connection supplies the result eventually displayed in judgment.
Emergence into clarity supplies the transition from hidden allegiance to exposed relation.
Disclosure by speech or sign anticipates the evidentiary speech of the body.
A barrier between sides supplies the earlier concealed separation that judgment later reveals.
Sorting until one thing is distinct from another immediately stages clarity as separation.
Intelligible speech connects witness and hearer even after mouths are sealed.
Evidence stated from knowledge turns bodily action into disclosure.
Hidden interior material supplies what cannot remain concealed.
Open manifestation completes the movement from concealed allegiance to public evidence.

structural_cues: The focus follows the command to separate the guilty at 36:59.
The clear qualifier recurs with record, message, error, recitation, and the disputing human at 36:12, 36:17, 36:24, 36:47, 36:69, and 36:77.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden barriers, judicial sorting, bodily speech, testimony, and secret/public exposure; I infer that the enemy is called manifest because his relation becomes demonstrable in its products, while simple adjectival clarity remains primary and live.

changed_reading.before: The enemy is already obvious to the addressee.
changed_reading.after: The enemy's hostility is made evidentially plain when hidden service yields separation, sorting, and testimony from the very acts it organized.

context_deltas.mechanism: Humans are shown as owners and beneficiaries of creatures made tractable, then as participants in a false-service relation described through a mustered host; worship reverses granted agency into volunteered subordination.

activation_trace.role: Owned servitude supplies the lower pole into which agency can be reversed.
Reduction to slave-like labor makes false service an inversion of agency.
Possession and disposal establish the agency granted to the human beneficiaries.
Making a difficult creature tractable supplies the proper downward direction of service in the scene.
A mutually supporting host converts private allegiance into organized service.
Being brought into attendance gives the host relation a compelled or mustered endpoint.

structural_cues: 36:71-72 grants ownership, riding, and food from made-tractable animals.
36:74-75 immediately reverses the picture into adopted gods, failed help, and a host brought into attendance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ownership, tractability, false gods, failed aid, and a present host; I infer an agency reversal from beneficiary to servant, while the pronoun direction in the host relation should remain explicitly qualified.

changed_reading.before: Worshipping Satan is allegiance to the wrong master.
changed_reading.after: Worshipping Satan is the reversal by which a creature granted usable agency volunteers itself as slave and deployable host.

context_deltas.mechanism: The filial root's construction image meets carried descendants, a formed body, acting limbs, and bodily reversal; the addressed lineage is both genealogical succession and an embodied structure that records whose service directed it.

activation_trace.role: A composed constitution lets the filial address resonate with embodied structure as well as descent.
Lineage keeps that structural resonance anchored in the direct sense of descendants.
Bearing an entrusted burden lets carried descent also carry responsibility.
A witnessing sign makes the body's component acts legible as evidence.
Acting limbs make acquisition an embodied record rather than an abstract account.
A completed bodily formation supplies the built constitution that can later be reversed.
Turning a thing onto its head shows the composed human structure losing its prior orientation.

structural_cues: 36:41 carries descendants, 36:65 turns hands and feet into witnesses, and 36:68 reverses the created form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, carried burden, bodily witness, acquisition by limbs, formed constitution, and reversal; I infer that the filial address can activate an embodied architecture of responsibility, while the straightforward genealogical vocative remains the controlling alternative.

changed_reading.before: The descendants of Adam are collectively addressed.
changed_reading.after: The carried human line is addressed as an embodied construction whose own components will reveal which service organized its acts.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a supplied split resolution carries the enemy root toward return and habit rather than ordinary hostility. It remains anchored in the focus root and is reinforced by recurring movement and path-making service, but downstream prose should label it a recurrence-model activation, not a lexical replacement for enemy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The enemy noun at word 12 resolves in the packet to a return-and-habit inventory as well as the dominant enmity inventory.

activation_trace.role: Habit formed by practice recasts the adversarial relation as a recurrent behavioral groove.
A road smoothed by use supplies the material effect of repeated obedient return.
Return after departure supplies a visible recurring motion within the surah.
A temporal occurrence capable of repetition sharpens the loop as repeated enactment.

changed_reading.before: The enemy confronts the human from outside.
changed_reading.after: The enemy can also be the habituated return of obedience to the same rival route until recurrence itself carries the hostility.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because a supplied split resolution carries the enemy root toward counting and prepared equipment. It remains anchored by that packet mapping and by the surah's many, gathered, and mustered groups, but it should be rendered only as an organizational analogy, not as the noun's direct gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The enemy noun at word 12 also resolves to the packet's counting-and-preparation inventory.

activation_trace.role: Counting and grouping supply the enemy relation with a population-scale organization.
Prepared stores and equipment turn that organization into deployable capacity.
Gathering dispersed units supplies the population-scale assembly.
A multitude as large as a mountain supplies the scale of those redirected.
A mutually supporting host supplies the organized adversarial formation.
Being brought into attendance makes the counted host ready for deployment or judgment.

changed_reading.after: At the exploratory organizational level, enemy also activates a system that counts, prepares, gathers, and musters redirected multitudes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The disease-transfer branch makes this a deliberately cross-domain reading. It remains anchored in the supplied enemy inventory and the focus address to descendants, with generation and dispersal cues in context, but downstream prose must state that transmission is a social-material analogy and not a medical claim or direct gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The enemy noun's transfer branch meets the descendant address within the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: A condition crossing from one bearer to another supplies a propagation model for hostility.
Lineal descent supplies the chain along which an adversarial pattern can be inherited.
People joined within one age supply distinct generational carriers.
Small units spreading outward supply the material image of propagation through descendants.
A mountain-like multitude shows the propagated pattern at generational scale.

changed_reading.before: Each person faces the same enemy independently.
changed_reading.after: An adversarial pattern can pass socially through generations, so maintaining the charge also interrupts transmission.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material reading is surprising because it activates the covenant root's recurring-rain branch. It remains anchored in the focus covenant and is reinforced by the surah's revived earth, flowing source, and fruit, but downstream prose should mark the watering mechanism as an analogical image of repeated care rather than a lexical substitution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The covenant verb at word 2 carries a branch image of rain that revisits and tends land.

activation_trace.role: Rain that revisits land supplies a recurring, restorative model of covenantal care.
Soft, fertile earth supplies the recipient that can retain and display renewed care.
Earth revived through rain and growth makes repeated tending visibly productive.
A wide opening with outflow supplies the release of sustaining water.
Ripened benefit supplies the result by which maintained care is recognized.

changed_reading.before: The covenant is a preserved legal instruction.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the covenant is also recurring care that revisits the human field so the inherited prohibition can remain alive and fruitful.

strongest_changes: The covenant became an intergenerational relay preserved in inscription, trace, and connected instruction.
Worship became cumulative path-making: repeated compliance lays the rival route and can harden into constraint.
The enemy's manifest quality became evidential, disclosed through separation, sorting, and embodied testimony.
The closing ownership and host sequence exposed false service as a reversal from granted agency into mustered subordination.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made movement and transmission unusually concrete: inherited charge, straight road, tether, blocked sight, return, sorting, bodily witness, and mustered service all re-entered the focus warning without requiring a single final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The return/habit and counting/preparation resolutions of ع د و are packet-authorized but form-distant and should remain exploratory.
The direction of the host relation at 36:75 affects how strongly the mastery-reversal model can be stated.
The construction resonance of ب ن ي may be secondary to its direct genealogical force.
The final qualifier can primarily denote ordinary clarity even though separation and evidentiary disclosure remain active.
